notes: From turn 2 on, ran unprotected R&D 3-4 times every turn even though each extra run only saw the same top card, while sitting at 0 credits with 4 tags and never clicking for money. Never contested Server 1 again after declining Bellona on turn 2, so Remastered Edition (turn 10) and Project Beale (turn 12) were scored freely.

Sound scoring behind Enigma against a runner with no decoder, but left R&D unprotected until turn 8 and lost Project Beale there on turn 2. Installed Breaking News naked in Server 2 on turn 3, clicked for credits while discarding on turns 9 and 11, and played Hard-Hitting News on turn 10 with no follow-up.

Never installed a single card and clicked for credits every turn from turn 2 to turn 9, reaching 42 credits. Made one Archives run and never contested the Server 1 scores of Send a Message, Obokata Protocol and Longevity Serum.

Installed Private Security Force (turn 8) and then Priority Requisition (turn 9) behind two Wall of Statics that Corroder breaks, and both were stolen. Wasted turns 10 and 12-14 playing Archived Memories to recover Archived Memories, and stacked 4 ice on HQ early while scoring was slow.

Won through steady Aumakua pressure on R&D and HQ, but facechecked HQ on turn 3 and Server 1 on turn 6 without a fitting breaker and let AR-Enhanced Security score on turn 7 unchallenged. Repeatedly left tags on (turns 11, 18, 20), letting the Corp trash Liberated Account, and often clicked for credits while holding 10 or more.

Won with Hard-Hitting News, Data Raven tags and High-Profile Target, but kept installing agendas behind a lone Hortum after Black Orchestra had broken it (Global Food Initiative on turn 8, Project Atlas on turn 11), giving up 6 points. Audacity on turn 10 trashed the whole HQ for nothing, and Consulting Visit for a do-nothing Economic Warfare on turn 15 wasted a turn.

Built a breaker suite, used Special Order to find Corroder, and won fast by taking two agendas from the remote and one from HQ on turns 5-6. Turns 2-4 were somewhat passive, with repeated Archives runs and credit clicks.

Ran R&D 4 times on turn 1 to see the same card, then clicked for credits every turn from turn 3 to turn 12, reaching 46 credits with no installs. Made one run (turn 9), so Director Haas' Pet Project, Efficiency Committee, Accelerated Beta Test and Project Vitruvius scored from remotes unchallenged.

Left R&D with only a Pop-up Window all game while the runner ran it every turn and stole 8 points there, yet stacked 4 ice on Server 1 instead. Biotic Labor on turn 3 was spent on credit clicks, and turns 5-6 were spent clicking for credits at 15+ credits while discarding.

Fast-advanced Hostile Takeover on turn 1, iced centrals, built money with IPO and NGO Front, and scored SDS Drone Deployment and SSL Endorsement behind Surveyor. Turn 5 was spent on idle credit clicks, and the agendas sat behind a single ice for several turns.

Scored 15 Minutes and two Global Food Initiatives behind Enigma with good money from Commercial Bankers Group and Hedge Fund. Left R&D with no ice all game while the runner ran it 4 times a turn, and drew into discards on turn 8.

Stole SDS Drone Deployment twice with good program-trash payments, but facechecked HQ on turn 1, Stimhacked into Mausolus on turn 5 and facechecked Surveyor on turn 8. On turn 12, after stealing to reach 6 points, a pointless Stimhack run on Archives cut the grip to 1 card and lost the game to Punitive Counterstrike.

Installed no ice for 7 turns and clicked for credits while discarding nearly every turn, reaching 27 credits with nothing to spend them on. Bellona was stolen from open HQ on turn 1 and Degree Mill from open R&D, Psychographics was played twice for nothing, and only one agenda was ever scored.

Ran R&D 4 times every turn where only the first run could see a new card, while stuck at 2 credits and never clicking for money. Ignored the naked remotes holding Commercial Bankers Group, Marilyn Campaign and Rashida Jaheem, letting the Corp reach 49 credits and score four agendas.

Pressured HQ and R&D steadily with Corroder, Temüjin Contract money and Film Critic and outlasted the Corp to win. Facechecked Resistor without link on turn 5, ran Archives slowly for money, and played Freedom Through Equality on turn 24 for no clear benefit.

Played Dedication Ceremony on the runner's Paperclip (turn 2) and Hippo (turn 5) for nothing, and on turn 6 used Consulting Visit to find Audacity, trashing all of HQ and dropping to 0 credits. Left R&D thin while the runner stole 3 agendas there, then put Above the Law behind a single Mausolus on turn 19, where it was stolen.

Won with a clever Paparazzi plus Data Leak Reversal mill into Archives, backed by Scrubber money. Hoarded 29 credits while permanently tagged and lost them all to Closed Accounts on turn 10, and the early Archives runs on turns 3-6 gained little.

Never installed an agenda in the 4-ice Server 1, held two Obokata Protocols in HQ behind a single Mlinzi and lost both on turns 11-12. Played Divert Power on turn 1 with nothing rezzed, and turns 3, 8 and 12 were idle credit clicks while sitting on 15+ credits.

Scored efficiently from an iced remote, including a turn-7 Biotic Labor score of AstroScript Pilot Program and then AstroScript-boosted Global Food Initiative. Left R&D unprotected until turn 6 against a runner hammering it 4 times a turn and lost Breaking News and Project Beale there, and declined Archangel four times on turn 5.

Repeated R&D runs on turns 1-2 that could only see the same top card, and never installed a breaker. Facechecked Border Control (turn 4) and Hortum (turn 5) with 1 credit, then spent turns 6-8 clicking for credits and draws while Oaktown Renovation and Global Food Initiative scored.
